decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and supports the firm's ergonomic workplace positioning, so modest results are still read as a normal ramp-up that does not justify reversing the launch.
The publicly announced G2 generation of a core interior luminaire is central to the LED portfolio, and dropping it so soon would undercut both the investment and the firm's public positioning.
As a flagship of the firm's announced direction, the microprismatic pendant carries the highest public commitment, so any weakness is attributed to temporary market conditions.

The withdrawal of the naval line and the HMI technology's conflict with the LED strategy make this the most exposed product, but sunk certification costs and loyal maritime customers still favor one more year.
The marine searchlight remains part of the robust specialist niche the firm has invested in, although dropping the naval line weakens the case for the marine offering and raises its risk somewhat.
